description: This Java class 'HeaderEntryFilters' provides factory methods to create various HeaderEntryFilter instances for filtering header entries based on external headers, internal acknowledgements, and header existence within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter project.

classes.name: HeaderEntryFilters
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods to create HeaderEntryFilter instances for different filtering scenarios.

methods.name: toExternalHeadersFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter to exclude headers not meant for external headers and discards internal Ditto acknowledgement requests if header definitions are provided.

methods.name: fromExternalHeadersFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter to include only headers that can be read from external headers, also reading JSON arrays from headers.

methods.name: existsAsHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Creates a filter to include only headers that are defined as HeaderDefinitions.

methods.name: existsAsHeaderDefinitionAndExternal
methods.description: Creates a combined filter to include headers that exist as HeaderDefinitions and are suitable for external headers.
